description_for_human: Autonomous self-hosted AI desktop agent for Linux with multi-LLM support, VNC desktop control, WhatsApp integration, RAG knowledge base, and MCP tool server integration.
description_for_model: Jarvis is a self-hosted autonomous AI agent that controls a full Linux desktop environment via VNC. It supports multiple LLM providers (Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, OpenRouter, Ollama), multi-agent orchestration, RAG with hybrid search (FAISS + BM25) and an optional knowledge graph, vulnerability checks of installed packages, MCP tool servers, WhatsApp messaging, face recognition, and an extensible skill system via OpenClaw marketplace. Install via Docker or curl script. Elastic License 2.0 (source-available).
